role_summary: Strategic leadership role focused on enterprise architecture, legacy core system modernization, and scalable, responsible AI adoption in a regulated insurance environment.
must_have_requirements: 15+ years in enterprise technology or large-scale digital transformation
Proven leadership in core system modernization within insurance or financial services
Deep expertise in Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP, or AliCloud)
Extensive experience in microservices, API-first, and event-driven architectures
Hands-on experience implementing AI/ML solutions at scale in business use cases
Fluency in both English and Chinese (written and spoken)
Strong understanding of IT governance, regulatory compliance, and risk management
nice_to_have_requirements: Experience with DevSecOps and automation pipelines
Proven track record in building and mentoring high-performing architecture teams
Strong background in Actuarial or Underwriting digital enablement
soft_skills_priority: Strategic communication with C-suite and ExCo
Pragmatic decision-making (balancing innovation vs. operational stability)

scoring_criteria.name: Relevant Tenure
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Ensures sufficient experience for ExCo-level strategic impact.
scoring_criteria.gap_expected: Candidates with <12 years may lack enterprise-wide maturity.

scoring_criteria.name: Core Insurance/Finance Domain Experience
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Necessary for understanding regulatory-constrained modernization of policy/claims systems.

scoring_criteria.name: Legacy Modernization Track Record
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Direct responsibility for moving from legacy to cloud-native platforms.

scoring_criteria.name: AI Innovation at Scale
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Must demonstrate AI beyond experimentation; requires integration into business value chains.

scoring_criteria.name: Stakeholder Management
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Critical to influence business units and alignment with compliance/security.

scoring_criteria.name: Architecture Governance
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Ability to set standards and guardrails for delivery teams.

scoring_criteria.name: Language Proficiency
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Required for regional communication in Asia markets.

scoring_criteria.name: Leadership Capability
scoring_criteria.why_it_matters: Required to build and scale horizontal architecture teams.

summary_focus: High-level impact on digital transformation and AI integration within the insurance sector.
do_not_overclaim: Do not claim AI expertise if limited only to personal/academic training; must show business value.

cover_letter_guidance.positioning: Bridge between business complexity and modern technological solutioning.
bridge_gaps_honestly: Emphasize transferrable skills from other highly regulated sectors if pure insurance experience is lacking.
